title: Require Typed Service Effect Error Authority
forbids: global Error or a same-source subclass of global Error in an explicit two- or three-argument Effect.Effect failure slot in service production source
why: Each fallible service capability must expose a typed failure vocabulary at its owning port or error owner. The pinned effect-orpc provider then maps declared public ORPCTaggedError outcomes without an untyped Error tunnel.
remediate: Replace Error failure slots with a port-owned Data.TaggedError, a deliberately serialized tagged error, or the pinned provider's contract-declared ORPCTaggedError. Translate foreign failures once at the owning boundary.
message: Service Effect failure channels must use typed owned errors.
